title: Electrician
description:
Position: Electrician
Location: Southern Cross Properties Ltd - POM
Duties and Responsibilities includes
Responsible for unscheduled and preventative maintenance
Conducting inspections of electrical utilities on a scheduled basis
Responsible for Service Maintenance AC’S,  Gen  Sets
Supervising and leading small maintenance team
Requirements:
Must be a Qualified Licensed Electrician (PNG Power License) or Tradesman (NATTB Certified)
Must have 5+ years working experience in a similar role.
Must possess strong troubleshooting ability and attend to call outs
Must have excellent communication and people management skills
Must Hold Current a Driver’s License
Please submit your application including a resume and cover letter to email
